annotations.title: Mark a fix on your Audit's list

description: Set one fix's state: fixed when you made it, as_is to leave it as it is (with a one-line reason, shown on your certificate), doesnt_apply when our finding is wrong or not for you (with a one-line reason; a person answers within 2 working days), open to undo. Then ask for a new drive (followup_drive) to check your fixes.

n.description: The fix's number on the list (audit_fixes)

reason.description: as_is and doesnt_apply: why, in one line
